dialogue.content: こんばんは本日は宜しくお願い致します。時間が来ましたら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for choosing to consult with me today. We will begin when it is time.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ　よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Let's begin, shall we?

dialogue.content: お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 相談員です。ご相談ありがとうございます。相談させていただくにあたり年齢と性別を教えていただきますか？
dialogue.English: I’m the counselor. Thank you for reaching out. Before we begin, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 年齢４６才　女性です
dialogue.English: I’m 46 years old, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 最近仕事に行くのに気分がブルーになります
dialogue.English: Recently, I've been feeling blue about going to work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。おつらいですね、何か気になることがありましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be tough. Is there something specific that's bothering you?

dialogue.content: 昨年から派遣で働いているのですが、
dialogue.English: Well, I've been working as a temp since last year, and...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 上司にたいして不信感を持ってきました
dialogue.English: I've started to feel a sense of mistrust towards my boss.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、どのようなことで、でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you tell me more about what led to that?

dialogue.content: はいった当初は仕事もある程度決まった事をするという約束でした
dialogue.English: When I first started, the agreement was that I would be doing a fairly set range of tasks.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: それを社員の人に教えてもらい、半年が過ぎたころから
dialogue.English: A full-time employee taught me how to do them, and after about six months...

dialogue.content: 慣れてきて　一日の仕事も余裕でできていたのですが
dialogue.English: I had gotten used to it and could easily handle a day’s work, but…

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: １年が過ぎたころから　なぜか仕事が山のように回ってきて
dialogue.English: But after about a year, for some reason, they started piling work on me.

dialogue.content: 毎日がへとへとです
dialogue.English: and I’ve been exhausted every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはしんどいですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds very taxing.

dialogue.content: 初めの話と違ってきて社員並みの仕事になっています
dialogue.English: It's different from what I was told at the beginning; I'm now doing the same level of work as a full-time employee.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、約束が違いますね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's not what was agreed upon.

dialogue.content: 二人分の面倒な処理を私一人がするようになっています
dialogue.English: I've ended up handling tedious tasks that were meant for two people all by myself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、随分お疲れでしょう。
dialogue.English: I see. You must be quite exhausted.

dialogue.content: 最近疲れがたまって仕事から逃げたくなっています
dialogue.English: Lately, the fatigue has been building up, and I feel like running away from work.

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね。お仕事の内容や職場の構成などをお聞かせいただいてもいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That sounds very difficult. Could you tell me a little about the nature of your work and the structure of your workplace?

dialogue.content: 上司が一人(男性)　社員が二人　と私の４人です
dialogue.English: There's one boss (male), two full-time employees, and me, so four of us.

dialogue.content: 工場の材料を仕入れます　他の工場から注文がきたら発注をします
dialogue.English: We procure materials for the factory. When an order comes from another factory, we place an order.

dialogue.content: 私の仕事にミスがあったら工場はストップします
dialogue.English: If I make a mistake in my work, the factory stops.

dialogue.content: 教えていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 従業員は１００人くらいいるらしいです
dialogue.English: Apparently there are about 100 employees.

dialogue.content: 工場の中の従業員です
dialogue.English: I mean the employees in the factory.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは重要なお仕事を任されておられましね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you've been entrusted with a very important job.

dialogue.content: 入った当初はそんな重要な仕事とは思っていなかったです
dialogue.English: When I first started, I didn't think it was such an important job.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは徐々にお仕事が増えてきたということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, would you say the amount of work has increased gradually?

dialogue.content: はいこの半年間でいっきに増えました
dialogue.English: Yes—it surged all at once over the past six months.

dialogue.content: 少し整理をさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Let me try to summarize, if that's alright.

dialogue.content: 量というよりいつどれだけの仕事がくるか把握ができません
dialogue.English: It's not so much the volume, but that I can't predict when or how much work will come in.

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Please do.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。気を抜くと大変なことになりそうですね。派遣でお仕事をされるようになり、半年ぐらいたつと慣れて余裕も出で来られていた。でも
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like if you let your guard down, it could become a big problem. After you started as a temp, about six months in you had gotten used to it and had some breathing room. But…

dialogue.content: 徐々にお仕事の量が増え、見通しがつかないくらいお忙しい状態で、
dialogue.English: then the workload gradually increased, to the point where it’s hard to see ahead,

dialogue.content: お体もずいぶんお疲れでしんどいし、当初と話が違っているという感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: and you're also physically exhausted and you feel that this is different from what was initially discussed. Is that right?

dialogue.content: 責任も増してこられていますね。
dialogue.English: Your responsibilities have also increased.

dialogue.content: そうです流れ的にはそんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s basically how it’s been.

dialogue.content: はい、責任は大変大きいです
dialogue.English: Yes, the responsibility is very heavy.

dialogue.content: お仕事が増えてきているのは、あなたに十分任せられるということを上の方が判断されて、
dialogue.English: Your workload has increased because your superiors have judged that you are capable enough to be entrusted with it...

dialogue.content: ということではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: wouldn’t you say?

dialogue.content: 最初は自分ながらに少しはうぬぼれていましたが、最近は少し反感を感じています
dialogue.English: At first, I was a little proud of myself, but recently I've started to feel some resentment.

dialogue.content: 仕事も暇な時は次の仕事をやる気はありました
dialogue.English: When things were slow, I was willing to take on the next task.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それほどしんどいのですね。お二人の社員の方と比べてお仕事の量をどのように感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like it's become that difficult for you. How does your workload compare to that of the two full-time employees?

dialogue.content: 他の二人はPC上でパチパチと座って打ち込んでいます　私はプリントをしたり立ったり座ったりで動くことも多いです
dialogue.English: The other two sit and type away at their PCs, while I’m printing things, standing up and sitting down—a lot of moving around.

dialogue.content: 雑用は最初からあったので　当然のようにしていました
dialogue.English: The miscellaneous chores were part of the job from the start, so I just did them as a matter of course.

dialogue.content: 立ったり座ったり動かないといけないのですね。
dialogue.English: So you have to be on your feet and moving around.

dialogue.content: だけど発注の仕事が増えたころからは自分の仕事に追われています
dialogue.English: But since the ordering work increased, I've been swamped with my own tasks.

dialogue.content: これは社員の仕事ではないかと思っています
dialogue.English: I feel like this is a full-time employee's job.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、あなたは雑用やプリントやご自分の仕事まで
dialogue.English: I see, so you're handling miscellaneous tasks, printing, and your own work...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 幅広くこなされていて、とても皆さんの頼りになられていますね。ですから
dialogue.English: You handle a wide range of tasks, so everyone must really rely on you. That's why...

dialogue.content: お仕事を何でも任されてしまわれるのですね。
dialogue.English: you end up having all sorts of work entrusted to you.

dialogue.content: 任されると言われても失敗をしたら大損害です　私のする仕事ではないと思います
dialogue.English: You say I'm entrusted with it, but if I make a mistake, it causes a huge loss. I don't think this is a job I should be doing.

dialogue.content: 実際にありました
dialogue.English: It's actually happened before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。そんなに重要なお仕事をあなたはされているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you are doing such a critical job.

dialogue.content: 重要かどうかは他の仕事を見ないとわかりませんが派遣のお役目かどうかは疑問です
dialogue.English: I don't know if it's critical compared to other jobs, but I question whether it's the role of a temp worker.

dialogue.content: 大損害をするかもしれないことを上司の方はどう思われていますか？
dialogue.English: What does your supervisor think about the possibility of large losses?

dialogue.content: 最初はたいした問題になることはないとか　対処方法はあるから心配しなくていいと言ってくれました
dialogue.English: At first he told me it wouldn’t become a big problem and that there were ways to handle it, so not to worry.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。しかし任す上司も責任があり、何かの時には責任を取らないといけなくなりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. But the boss who assigns the work also has a responsibility and would have to take responsibility if something happened.

dialogue.content: それを今回ミスをしたときはどれだけの損害になるか計算をさせらされました
dialogue.English: But this time when I made a mistake, he made me calculate how much the damages would be.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは派遣としてのあなたには荷が重いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That’s a heavy burden for you as a temp.

dialogue.content: 私の態度は失敗を反省していない　焦りすらもないように見えるとかいってきて
dialogue.English: He told me my attitude showed no remorse for the mistake, that I didn't even seem fazed.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もっと自分の言った通りに有動けとばかりに何か支配的な態度になってきました
dialogue.English: And he's become somewhat domineering, as if telling me to just move exactly as he says.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。でもきっとあなたは上司の期待に応えるお仕事をされているのだと思います。しかし
dialogue.English: I see. But I'm sure you are doing work that meets your boss's expectations. However...

dialogue.content: 今後は正直な気持ちを伝えるというのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: how about trying to communicate your honest feelings going forward?

dialogue.content: 上司に伝えるのがいいのでしょうか？　それとも派遣会社にいうべきでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Should I tell my boss? Or should I tell the temp agency?

dialogue.content: 忠実にお仕事されてきたあなたなら、どちらのほうが効果的かをお分かりになると思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since you've been working so diligently, I think you might have a sense of which would be more effective. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 職場の上司はその時ばかりに言いくるめられる気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like my supervisor at the site would just talk me around in the moment.

dialogue.content: 気分でころころ変わる人です
dialogue.English: He's the type of person who changes with his mood.

dialogue.content: 派遣先に言うのはもう辞める時です
dialogue.English: Telling the agency is for when I'm ready to quit.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それなのによく頑張ってこられましたね。
dialogue.English: I see. Despite that, you've been doing so well to persevere.

dialogue.content: 仕事は楽しいのです
dialogue.English: The work itself is enjoyable.

dialogue.content: もくもくとするのも嫌ではないので
dialogue.English: I don't mind just quietly getting on with it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それをきいて安心しました。それなら
dialogue.English: I see. I’m relieved to hear that. In that case,

dialogue.content: 上司の方に正直にお伝えして、自分の立場に応じたお仕事をいただけるように伝えてみられたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: how about honestly telling your boss and asking to be given work that is appropriate for your position?

dialogue.content: わかりました　少し考えてみたいと思います
dialogue.English: Understood. I’d like to think about it a bit.

dialogue.content: 忠実に頑張ってこられたあなただから上司に伝えてよいと思います。
dialogue.English: Because you've worked so diligently, I think it would be fine to tell your boss.

dialogue.content: あまり信頼をしていない上司なのですが大丈夫でしょうか
dialogue.English: I don’t trust my supervisor very much—would that still be okay?

dialogue.content: はい、上司の方はあなたを信頼しておられますよ、あなたに重要なお仕事を任せられているのですから。
dialogue.English: Yes. Your supervisor trusts you; after all, they’re entrusting you with important work.

dialogue.content: わかりました　ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I understand. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for consulting with me today.

dialogue.content: お世話になりました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: こちらこそです。終了させていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: The pleasure was all mine. May I conclude our session now?

dialogue.content: はい　お願いいたします
dialogue.English: Yes, please do.
